headline: Cash Outside Nigerian Banking System Reaches N4.92 Trillion in September
summary: Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria showed that the total amount of currency circulating outside the formal banking system increased to N4.92 trillion in September 2026.
why: High levels of physical cash outside commercial banks constrain monetary policy transmission and domestic deposit mobilization in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigerian Commercial Banks
impacts.why: Higher unbanked cash circulation reduces retail deposit growth across the financial system.
